title: _Nonnull annotation contradicts documented NULL behavior in tx_queue_empty
description:
Line 200 documents 'NULL returns true' but line 202 declares the parameter as _Nonnull. If implementation trusts _Nonnull and skips NULL check, callers relying on documented behavior get undefined behavior. Either change annotation to _Nullable or remove NULL handling from docs.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 202
close_reason: Fixed: Changed _Nonnull to _Nullable on tx_queue_empty() parameter to match documented NULL behavior and implementation. Tests pass (19/19).
